analysis.summary_en: ThinkRail is an agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it.
highlights: Skills. ThinkRail loads your pi skills and any already in your project. It can also import skills from Claude, Codex, and other coding agents: switch them on in Settings → Extensions & skil…
Engine (packages/server + packages/shared): a Bun.serve HTTP+WS host with one in-process pi session per chat, launched by apps/cli or apps/desktop.
GUI (apps/web): React 19 + Zustand + Tailwind v4, shipped independently; it communicates with the engine through the contracts.
